extra_world_events.title: Urgent: Grand Proclamation Draft Posted
extra_world_events.description: A preliminary draft of the Grand Proclamation has been posted in The Syntax Exchange, awaiting 'factional review' before final ink. Censors are expected to patrol soon.

extra_world_events.title: Censor Patrol Initiated in Sluice
extra_world_events.description: A Censor's patrol has begun in The Phonetic Sluice, actively scanning for semantic discrepancies in incoming language. Suspicious phrasing will be flagged.

extra_world_events.title: Dialect Duel Challenge Posted
extra_world_events.description: A new challenge has been posted in the Council, seeking rare idioms to sway neutral ambassadors. A disgraced scholar could find an opportunity here.

extra_world_events.title: Rare Idiom Forgery Suspected
extra_world_events.description: Whispers circulate in The Syntax Exchange of a forged idiom used in the nascent Dialect Duel, threatening to discredit a participant. Investigation needed.

extra_world_events.title: Minor Leak in Vowel Archive
extra_world_events.description: A small but persistent leak has been discovered near the older Vowel Stasis Pods in the Archive of Lost Vowels, threatening delicate phonetic records. Immediate attention is required to prevent data loss.

extra_world_events.title: Suspicious Redaction Flagged in Proclamation Draft
extra_world_events.description: A censor's glyph has appeared next to a critical passage in the Grand Proclamation draft in The Syntax Exchange, indicating a detected attempt to alter factional influence. The deadline looms.

extra_world_events.title: Rumor: Censor Bribed for Proclamation Access
extra_world_events.description: Whispers suggest a Censor in The Phonetic Sluice has been offered a 'linguistic favor' for early access to the Grand Proclamation draft, potentially allowing pre-emptive redactions or counter-redactions.

extra_world_events.title: Idiom Authenticity Dispute Escalates in Council
extra_world_events.description: The suspected idiom forgery has led to a formal dispute in the Council, demanding linguistic arbitration to verify its authenticity before the duel proceeds. A disgraced scholar could gain renown by proving or disproving it.

extra_world_events.title: Neutral Ambassador's Favor Becomes Key in Duel
extra_world_events.description: A key neutral ambassador has expressed interest in a specific rare dialect, making them a target for duel participants. Winning their favor could dramatically shift the tides of public opinion in the Dialect Duel.

extra_world_events.title: Archive Leak Worsens, Threatens Ancient Lexicon
extra_world_events.description: The minor leak in the Archive of Lost Vowels has intensified, now threatening a critical section of the Ancient Lexicon. Urgent intervention is needed to prevent irreversible loss of linguistic history.
